name: graphlens
description: GraphLens - interactive relationship graph exploration for Splunk. Independent third-party application; does not require Neo4j.
author: Adam Liquorish

scripts.typecheck: echo 'GraphLens uses JSDoc + PropTypes rather than TypeScript; see DEVELOPMENT.md. No separate type-check step.'
scripts.build: npm run clean && webpack --config webpack.config.js --mode production
scripts.package: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && bash scripts/package_app.sh
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
